mkdir -p $TMPDIR/an && cat > $TMPDIR/an/parse.py <<'EOF'
import re, glob, os, json, collections
base = "/tmp/r2run-in27zggi/data/text"
cases = []
for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(base, "*.txt"))):
    txt = open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    pages = re.split(r"^=== page \d+\s*$", txt, flags=re.M)
    for pi, p in enumerate(pages):
        if "Case Number" not in p: continue
        m = re.search(r"Damage Location:\s*(.*)", p)
        cn = re.search(r"Case Number:\s*(.*)", p)
        resp = re.search(r"Respondent:\s*(.*)", p)
        cites = re.findall(r"IC\s*8-1-26-[^\s]*", p)
        cites2 = re.findall(r"finds the following violation\(s\):(.*?)The Advisory", p, flags=re.S)
        cases.append(dict(file=os.path.basename(f), page=pi, case=cn.group(1).strip() if cn else None,
            resp=resp.group(1).strip() if resp else None, loc=m.group(1).strip() if m else None,
            cites=cites, viol=cites2[0].strip() if cites2 else None, raw=p))
print(len(cases))
print(collections.Counter(os.path.basename(f) for f in []))
json.dump(cases, open(os.environ["TMPDIR"]+"/an/cases.json","w"))
EOF
python3 -I $TMPDIR/an/parse.py

Method:
- I parsed the 58 order text files into recommendation forms. The text layer contains 9,964 case-number pages, of which 9,809 have a damage location line.

- Spelling variants are not merged, per your definition.
